Robert Louis Stevenson, Travel Essays.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/robert-louis-stevenson/travel-essays

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Robert Louis Stevenson, the author, died 1894 (Wikidata Q1512, P570 = 1894-12-03).

First publication of the text used: not stated in the facts; the essays were written between 1871 and 1892 (SE colophon: 'Travel Essays was compiled from essays written between 1871 and 1892 by Robert Louis Stevenson.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the colophon gives no first-publication year for the compilation. The Standard Ebooks rights statement below says the text is in the United States public domain, and that statement covers the United States side.
- Country of origin: every person named above died in 1894 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: 'Travel Essays was compiled from essays written between 1871 and 1892 by Robert Louis Stevenson.'
- Wikidata Q1512 (Robert Louis Stevenson), P570 = 1894-12-03; Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Louis_Stevenson
